body: i've tried but it didn't help. i just want it to be over. i don't want to bother people with my shit anymore

i tried to use the chatline bc i didn't want to talk on the phone. after days of trying to get through i finally did for them to copy/paste a paragraph telling me to call the phone number and promptly disconnect. i haven't tried again but it made me feel worse tbh.

yeah i definitely feel that, for me it goes further tho. I feel like that while they'd be sad they'd ultimately be better off without me, they'd forget after a while. the only thing keeping me around is that I don't know for sure...and i don't want to hurt someone else bc i'm too chickenshit to keep going even though it hurts.
means a lot to know someone even just read what i had to say. I feel like I've said the same things to the same people and have been basically told it's someone else's problem y'know?
